result.instructions: freemapper-print prints orienteering maps from OpenOrienteering Mapper files as PDFs at an exact scale, one sheet per course or per layout. A project is a folder with a freemapper-print.toml that names the map, the optional course file (Purple Pen or IOF XML) and the layouts. Start with project_info to see what a project holds, then check_project to see the notes of every sheet. init_project starts a project; masks_window, masks_corridor, numbers_accept, set_layout, set_element and assign_mask change the project file and keep its comments. Run check_project after a change to see its effect. export_project writes the PDFs. Paths must be absolute because the server does not know your working folder. The messages in the results are German or English; pass lang to choose. Manual and source: https://github.com/HenryJobst/freemapper-print

shortened: each input field shows only its description

tools.name: assign_mask
tools.description: Set the mask variant a course prints with: a [[masks]] entry of the project file or a white-out area of the course file (whiteout-<n>); project_info lists them. Without mask the course prints without one. layout moves the course to another layout as well. Returns the assignment and change: added, changed or unchanged.

properties.course: The course of the course file.
properties.lang: Language of the messages: "de" or "en". Default: the language the server started with.
properties.layout: The layout the course prints on. Left out: the layout it prints on now.
properties.mask: The mask variant: a [[masks]] id or whiteout-<n>. Left out or null: the course prints without one.
properties.project: Absolute path of freemapper-print.toml or of the folder that holds it.

tools.name: check_project
tools.description: Draw every sheet of a project in memory, as the check command does, and return the notes of each sheet. With a course file there is one sheet per course, then one per layout without a course. Each note has kind, severity (info, warning or error), course and message. needs_attention is true when a note is more than info or a sheet could not be drawn, on any sheet. At most 200 sheets and 200 notes come back; more_sheets and more count the rest, and more_sheets_needing_attention counts the sheets left out that need attention.

properties.lang: Language of the messages: "de" or "en". Default: the language the server started with.
properties.project: Absolute path of freemapper-print.toml or of the folder that holds it.

tools.name: export_project
tools.description: Write the PDFs of a project into out_dir, as the export command does. Without a course file it writes one PDF per layout, with one a PDF per course, named after the course. single_file puts the courses on the pages of one PDF instead. layouts prints the named layouts without courses and does not go with courses or single_file. The tool replaces a PDF of the same name in out_dir. Returns the files with their size, the notes of the sheets and the reminder to print at actual size. At most 200 files and 200 notes come back; more_files and more count the rest. When the client cancels the call, the export stops after the sheet it is drawing.

properties.courses: Only these courses, by name. Default: every course of the course file.
properties.lang: Language of the messages: "de" or "en". Default: the language the server started with.
properties.layouts: These layouts by id, printed without courses. Does not go with courses or single_file.
properties.out_dir: Absolute path of the folder for the PDFs. It must exist.
properties.project: Absolute path of freemapper-print.toml or of the folder that holds it.
properties.single_file: All courses as the pages of one PDF.

tools.name: init_project
tools.description: Write a new project file freemapper-print.toml for a map into a folder, as the init command does. With a course file there is one layout per print scale and an assignment per course. The tool refuses a folder that holds a project file already. Returns the layouts written, where the map kind came from, and the messages of init. The layouts name at most 200 courses in all; more_courses counts the rest.

properties.courses:
Absolute path of a course file (Purple Pen .ppen or IOF XML): one layout per print scale and an
assignment per course.
properties.folder:
Absolute path of the project folder. It is created when missing and must not hold a
freemapper-print.toml yet.
properties.kind:
The map kind. Default: map_kind in the map's freemapper.toml, else inferred from the symbol set and
scale.
properties.lang: Language of the messages, and of the texts the new file puts on the sheet: "de" or "en".
properties.map: Absolute path of the map file (.omap or .xmap).
properties.title: The event title. Default: the title in the map's freemapper.toml, else the map's file name.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: The courses of the project's course file in file order, each with its number of controls, the layout it prints on and the masks its sheet applies. The list is empty when the project has no course file. At most 200 courses come back; more_courses counts the rest.

properties.lang: Language of the messages: "de" or "en". Default: the language the server started with.
properties.project: Absolute path of freemapper-print.toml or of the folder that holds it.

tools.name: masks_corridor
tools.description: Add a mask variant with a corridor along a line, as masks corridor does: on the sheet the map shows only inside the corridor. The width is mm on paper, so it needs a print scale: course names the course whose layout gives it. With assign that course prints with the new mask. Returns the mask id and the messages of the command.

properties.assign: Print the course named in course with the new mask; needs course.
properties.course:
The course whose layout gives the print scale for the width. Without it, all layouts must print at
one scale.
properties.lang: Language of the messages: "de" or "en". Default: the language the server started with.
properties.points: The line of the corridor in map mm, "x,y;x,y;...", at least two points.
properties.project: Absolute path of freemapper-print.toml or of the folder that holds it.
properties.width: Width of the corridor in mm on paper. Default: 10.

tools.name: masks_window
tools.description: Add a mask variant with round windows around the controls of a course, as masks window does: on the sheet the map shows only inside the windows. With assign the course prints with the new mask. Returns the mask id, the stops with a window and the messages of the command.

properties.assign: Print the course with the new mask.
properties.controls: The controls with a window, by code ("31,32") or by place in the course ("2-5"). Default: all.
properties.course: The course whose controls get a window.
properties.id: The mask id. Default: one made from the course name.
properties.lang: Language of the messages: "de" or "en". Default: the language the server started with.
properties.project: Absolute path of freemapper-print.toml or of the folder that holds it.
properties.radius: Radius of each window in mm on paper. Default: 15.
properties.radius_for: Windows with a radius of their own, each "CODE=MM" such as "35=20".

tools.name: numbers_accept
tools.description: Fix where the number of a control is printed, as numbers accept does. Without direction and gap it takes the free position that check_project proposes for the number. scope sheet changes the sheet of the course, layout_wide every course on its layout. Returns the correction written and the message of the command.

properties.direction: Direction of the number in degrees (0 is east, counter-clockwise). Goes with gap.
properties.gap: Gap between number and circle in mm on paper. Goes with direction.
properties.lang: Language of the messages: "de" or "en". Default: the language the server started with.
properties.project: Absolute path of freemapper-print.toml or of the folder that holds it.
properties.scope: sheet: this course's sheet; layout_wide: every course on its layout.

tools.name: project_info
tools.description: What a project holds: title, map kind and scale, the map and course file it reads, the layouts with their elements, the courses with the layout and masks each prints with, the mask variants and the assignments. At most 200 courses, 200 mask variants and 200 assignments come back; more_courses, more_masks and more_assignments count the rest.

properties.lang: Language of the messages: "de" or "en". Default: the language the server started with.
properties.project: Absolute path of freemapper-print.toml or of the folder that holds it.

tools.name: set_element
tools.description: Add a sheet element to a layout, or to the shared elements when layout is left out, or replace the element with the same id there. Which fields apply depends on kind: lines for title_block and text, size_pt for those and for credit_line and copyright_line, file and width_mm for logo, cell_mm for control_descriptions. Returns the element and change: added, changed or unchanged.

properties.box_white: title_block and text: a white box behind the text. Default: true.
properties.cell_mm: control_descriptions: printed side of one cell in mm, 4 to 10. Default: the rule profile's size.
properties.file: logo: absolute path of the image (PNG, JPEG or SVG). The file stores it relative to the project file.
properties.id: The element id; an element with this id there is replaced.
properties.lang: Language of the messages: "de" or "en". Default: the language the server started with.
properties.layout: The layout id. Left out: the element is shared by every layout.
properties.lines: title_block and text: the lines, with placeholders such as {event} or {course}.
properties.project: Absolute path of freemapper-print.toml or of the folder that holds it.
properties.size_pt: title_block, text, credit_line and copyright_line: the text size in pt.

tools.name: set_layout
tools.description: Add a layout to the project file, or change the layout with this id. A key left out keeps its value, or takes the default for a new layout. The elements of the layout stay as they are; set_element changes them. Returns the layout as the file now reads, and change: added, changed or unchanged.

properties.border_mm: Width of the frame line in mm; 0 draws none. Default for a new layout: 0.25.
properties.centre_map_mm: The map point (mm on the map sheet) in the centre of the map frame; null centres the printed area.
properties.crop: The frame cuts the map on purpose, so check reports it as information only.
properties.hide_parts: Map parts the layout does not print, by name.
properties.hide_shared: Ids of shared elements the layout does not show.
properties.id: The layout id; it names the PDF of the layout.
properties.lang: Language of the messages: "de" or "en". Default: the language the server started with.
properties.margin_mm: Width of the passe-partout around the map frame in mm. Default for a new layout: 8.
properties.north_lines: auto adds north lines when the map has none; never leaves them out.
properties.orientation: auto takes the orientation in which more of the map fits. Default for a new layout: auto.
properties.paper: Default for a new layout: A4.
properties.print_scale: The print scale denominator, such as 4000; null prints at the map scale.
properties.project: Absolute path of freemapper-print.toml or of the folder that holds it.
